_comment: Firebase Hosting config for the GCP deployment (gcp/). Terraform creates the site;
the content is released with `firebase deploy --only hosting`, because a Hosting deploy
is a content release rather than an infrastructure change.
The /api/** rewrite is the important line. It sends API calls to the Cloud Run service
from the site's own origin, so the browser never makes a cross-origin request and CORS
stops mattering - the same thing the CloudFront behaviour did for the Lambda URL in Lab 4.
Because of it the SPA is built with no VITE_API_URL at all: it calls /api/... relatively.
serviceId and region must match google_cloud_run_v2_service.api in gcp/run.tf.
